component.name: Auto-Updates
component.summary: Automated system package updates and reboot policy manager

description.p: Auto-Updates provides turnkey automated package maintenance for Linux systems, including Fedora, Rocky Linux, AlmaLinux, RHEL, Debian, and Ubuntu.
It features daily zero-day security updates, optional weekly full upgrades, intelligent build-process and compile protection, and interactive status reporting.

screenshot.caption: Real-time system status and scheduled update timer inspection
Interactive command-line interface and configuration options
Comprehensive Unix system administration manual page

description.p: Fix pre-build test gate in build_deb.sh on Debian 13 and Ubuntu 26.04: adapt test_cli.sh for Debian/Ubuntu reboot flag checks and allow cross-platform testing via AUTO_UPDATES_OS_TYPE and REBOOT_REQUIRED_FILE.

Fix false-positive reboot detection on DNF5 and Fedora: prioritize dnf5 with --disablerepo='*' and needs-restarting without mirror cache dependencies, and ensure exit code 1 is required for reboot trigger.
Fix test_cli.sh interactive PTY race condition: dynamically wait for TUI prompt to allow needs-restarting and package queries to complete on Rocky Linux and AlmaLinux build nodes.
Standardize interactive CLI TUI workflow: bare auto-updates invocation in interactive terminals automatically opens the TUI dashboard with interactive configure menu matching git-tools.
Add Ubuntu APT phased updates detection, configuration option, and DNF transaction conflict warnings.
Release 1.3.2: Automated sync and verification for Orchestra packaging, staging, and fleet QA.
End-to-end verification release for Orchestra packaging, staging, and fleet QA with two-tier interactive TUI prompt.
Two-tier interactive TUI workflow: initial status dashboard with [c] prompt to enter configuration menu or Enter to close.

Anti-reboot-loop safeguards: 15-minute system uptime safety floor, automated reboot rate limiter (1-hour cooldown), on-boot execution elimination, and package modification verification for when-changed policy.
Add full interactive Terminal User Interface (TUI) menu dashboard, direct desktop launcher integration, set-build-protection command, and comprehensive hypervisor architecture documentation.
Support configurable REBOOT_DELAY with immediate systemctl reboot (delay 0) to prevent unattended session timeout issues on virtual machines and servers.
Expand status dashboard Quick CLI reference with set-reboot policies (never, when-needed, when-changed), set-time, and set-day.
Display application version in status header and provide helpful CLI reference prompts and examples for interactive and launcher terminal sessions.
Integrate AppStream showcase screenshots, hero banner, and branding metadata for GNOME Software.
Dynamic package discovery in publish script and build stabilization.
Add desktop launcher and AppStream metainfo for GNOME integration.
Add multi-distribution support for Debian and Ubuntu with APT backend.
Initial production release for Fedora, Rocky Linux, and AlmaLinux.
